source_evidence: REITs provide a way for individual investors to earn a share of the income produced through commercial real estate ownership – without actually having to go out and buy commercial real estate.
answer: A Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) is a company that owns and typically operates income-producing real estate, such as apartments, offices, or warehouses. Investing in a REIT lets individuals participate in income from commercial real estate without buying and managing the property themselves.
